versions.changelog: v2.1.0: Complete production guide with compression optimizations, network timeout fixes, verified 3+ day stable deployment. Includes port mapping, NVENC setup, troubleshooting for zero incentive, and optimization history.

Bittensor Subnet 85 "Vibe Miner" Skill v1.0.0

- Provides a fully automated setup for mining Bittensor Subnet 85 (VidAIo), focused on GPU-accelerated video upscaling and compression.
- Guides users through hardware selection, TAO wallet setup, storage configuration (BackBlaze B2/Hippius), dependency installation, subnet registration, and miner deployment.
- Includes critical mining optimizations: VMAF quality scoring patch, video2x speed improvements, and Vast.ai port conflict workarounds.
- Offers dual miner setup (upscaler & compressor) and comprehensive monitoring tools.
- Features detailed troubleshooting, break-even analysis, and safety guidance based on live March 2026 mining data.
